correctness.rationale: The exact graph has twelve vertices and eighteen specified edges. All 4095 subsets were tested against the geometric Čech even/odd witness rule; complete acyclic Morse pairings at scales 0–4 have exactly the declared cells and zero integral boundary. A separate mod-two boundary computation agrees in every dimension. Homology inclusion is determined by explicit chain lifts and signed integral Morse projections. The H1 map from 1 to 2 has a ±1 3x3 minor (split surjection). The sole H2 cycle at 2 bounds three oriented tetrahedra at 3; both H3 cycles at 3 are single oriented 4-simplex boundaries at 4. The scale 5 full simplex kills all remaining homology. These data establish a direct integral interval decomposition; no scale-two homotopy statement is used. The self-contained verifier was rerun on actual packaged paths.
